summary: Checked in the sandbox with my own screenshots: the clay toadstool is a good-looking generated mesh that covers about 8% of a close frame, the T storm hint and message are legible, and the frame stays well under 33 ms. Small gaps remain in the film opening and in the KEEP lists.
surprise_why: The friends notice the old toadstool wobbling, it pops in spores and a real one springs up, and you can now call the storm yourself.

findings.what: The toadstool film spends its first ~4 s on the old red dome, which fills about half the frame, and the pop at 3.96 s is the largest jump in the film (0.070), a hard flash.
findings.evidence: reviews/motion/session-0077/toadstool-overview.jpg and toadstool-steps.jpg. My own sandbox shots show the new toadstool only: reviews/s77-b.png (ground view, cap about 8% of the frame), reviews/s77-c.png (high view, small, spots and a frill on the stem).
findings.suggestion: Start the film at the first wobble and spread the pop's burst over a few frames.

findings.what: beds.jl and presents.jl have a `const KEEP` without :storm. The other 14 event plugins have it, so sleepers or present-givers may be taken during a storm.
findings.evidence: grep -L storm over the files with '^const KEEP'
findings.suggestion: Add :storm to both, or confirm they are not event plugins.

findings.what: The storm sky is only 18% darker than a sunny frame (author's numbers). A full boing party on the new cap was not watched. My sandbox was idle at 11:10, so I did not see a storm or a party myself.
findings.evidence: media/s77/storm-light-during3.png (author's); frame_ms median 3.5 ms, p95 6.5 ms in my live_status
findings.suggestion: Darken the sky colour during a storm, and run a boing party on the new cap before the next film.

agent_notes: s78: (1) The toadstool film's first 4 s on the old dome: that is the story (the friends gather while the old one wobbles), and the pop is meant to be the jump; I trimmed the one wrong first frame. The new spring film opens on the bare meadow, which is quiet, not a dome. (2) beds.jl and presents.jl have no event KEEP tuple: beds' KEEP_CLEAR is a distance (1 m from bushes) and presents' KEEP is a time (150 s), so the grep matched names, not lists; all 16 event plugins now have :storm, :toadstool and the new :blossom. (3) The storm sky stays in todo 237. A full boing party on the new cap: the new toadstool's squash follows boing's wobble (media/s77/boing-squash.png); a party with flyers is still to be watched, the sandbox's friends were busy every time I tried.
